principles.heading: ## Design Principles
principles.intro: Composition rules for using these tokens, derived from the extracted values.

proximity.heading: ### Proximity
proximity.related: - Keep related items within `{{related}}`; separate groups with `{{group}}` or more
proximity.group: - Group with space from the scale instead of adding divider lines

alignment.heading: ### Alignment
alignment.scale: - Align repeated blocks to shared edges; size and space with the scale steps, never off-scale values
alignment.text: - Keep text columns on one inline start within a section

repetition.heading: ### Repetition
repetition.scale: - Reuse the extracted scale exactly ({{counts}}) — never invent near-duplicate values
repetition.coherence: - Coherence comes from repeating the same tokens, not from decorating individual elements

contrast.heading: ### Contrast
contrast.muted: - Use the foreground color for primary text and the muted color for secondary text
contrast.textRange: - Establish text hierarchy with the darkest and lightest extracted text colors, not size alone
contrast.primary: - Reserve the primary color for one key action per view; supporting actions stay neutral
contrast.states: - Keep hover, focus, and selected states in the same hue family as the action color

dos.heading: ### Do's
dos.colorTokens: - ✅ Use the defined color tokens instead of hardcoded hex values
dos.spacingScale: - ✅ Follow the spacing scale for consistent rhythm
dos.primaryFont: - ✅ Use `{{font}}` as the primary font stack
dos.generousRadius: - ✅ Use generous border-radius for a soft, friendly feel
dos.compactPillRadius: - ✅ Use compact radii on ordinary surfaces; preserve observed pill and circular button variants separately
dos.compactRadius: - ✅ Keep border-radius minimal for a sharp, precise aesthetic
dos.shadows: - ✅ Use elevation (shadows) to create visual hierarchy
dos.noShadowScale: - ✅ No stable shadow scale was observed; prefer observed borders and background shifts for hierarchy
dos.observedResponsive: - ✅ Preserve the observed responsive behavior across viewports
dos.declaredBreakpoints: - Breakpoints were declared, but responsive behavior was not observed in this capture
dos.recurringSpacing: - ✅ Use the spacing scale for recurring rhythm; keep observed component and structural exceptions exact

donts.heading: ### Don'ts
donts.derivedColors: - ❌ Don't present new colors as observed values; label and validate derived accessibility recommendations separately
donts.newColors: - ❌ Don't introduce new colors outside the defined palette
donts.fontFamilies: - ❌ Don't mix multiple font families — stick to the single typeface

principles.heading: Design principles
principles.intro: Composition rules for these tokens, derived from the theme values.
principles.proximityScale: - Keep related items within `calc({{unit}} * 2)`; separate groups with `calc({{unit}} * 6)` or more
principles.proximityDensity: - Group with the spacing scale instead of stacking dividers (density: {{density}})
principles.alignmentScale: - Size and space in multiples of {{unit}}; never use off-scale values
principles.alignmentSidebar: - Repeated blocks share one inline start and column width (sidebar {{sidebarWidth}})
principles.semanticSteps: - Reuse existing semantic token steps (colors, font sizes, radii, shadows); never invent near-duplicates
principles.textContrast: - Body text uses `--color-foreground`, secondary text `--color-muted-foreground`; hierarchy comes from contrast, not font-size stacking
principles.actionContrast: - One primary action per view (`--color-primary`); hover, selected, and focus states stay in the primary hue family — the signature contrast color appears only in the focus ring and selection indicators

agent.heading: Agent prompt guide
agent.intro: Use these design tokens to generate UI that matches the **{{theme}}** visual style.
agent.examplePrompt: Build a card component using the {{theme}} design system:

rules.source: 1. Treat this document as the single source of truth for visual rules.
rules.reuse: 2. Reuse semantic colors, fonts, spacing, radii, shadows, and motion — never invent approximations.
rules.hierarchy: 3. Preserve product hierarchy and interaction placement; only replace visual expression.
rules.heading: 4. Headings use `--font-heading` + `--tracking-heading` + `--leading-heading`.
rules.focus: 7. Focus states use `--focus-ring-shadow` instead of custom styles.

doRules.colors: - Use semantic color tokens (`--color-primary`), not hardcoded color values
doRules.spacing: - Use spacing multipliers (`calc(var(--spacing) * N)`) for consistent rhythm
doRules.radius: - Use `--radius-md` as default radius, `--radius-sm` for interactive elements
doRules.shadows: - Escalate shadows by level: cards sm, popovers md, modals lg

dontRules.fonts: - Don't mix font families; strictly separate body/heading/code roles
dontRules.colors: - Don't use color values outside of the CSS variable system
dontRules.motion: - Don't create custom easing; use `--motion-easing` uniformly
dontRules.density: - Don't ignore density; spacing multipliers should match the current density level

reconstruction.heading: ### Reconstruction Summary
reconstruction.avoidActionSubstitution: Do not substitute decorative, status, or border colors for the observed action role.
reconstruction.avoidInventedPrimary: Do not invent a primary action color; none was stably observed.
reconstruction.avoidGeometryGeneralization: Do not generalize one-off geometry into the reusable spacing scale.

howToUse.heading: ## How to Use
howToUse.catalogComplete: - This file contains observed evidence and deterministic, program-ranked claims.
howToUse.catalogImplementation: - Implement only deterministic claims supported by their cited evidence and keep every rule within its recorded URL, viewport, state, and confidence scope.
howToUse.observedOnly: - This file contains observed design tokens and structural evidence. Check it against the source before using it with a coding assistant.
howToUse.verify: - After implementation, compare against the current source or capture for visual hierarchy, density, and responsive behavior.
howToUse.formats: - For precise CSS variables or Tailwind theme configuration, use Imprint's corresponding export formats.

contrast.heading: ### Component Contrast Notes
contrast.inferredSuffix: The background comes from the shared-surface assumption for a transparent component; verify it in the real container.
contrast.warning: - `{{name}}`: foreground `{{foreground}}` over {{backgroundKind}} `{{background}}` is {{ratio}}:1, below the {{target}}:1 target for this {{controlKind}}.{{inferredSuffix}}
contrast.iconSchemaNote: - `{{name}}`: foreground `{{foreground}}` over {{backgroundKind}} `{{background}}` is {{ratio}}:1 and meets the 3:1 non-text icon target. The DESIGN.md alpha component field represents it as `textColor`, so a general validator may still apply the 4.5:1 text target.

catalog.boundedImplementation: Apply this fact only within the cited capture scope; verify any broader reuse separately.
catalog.unavailableStatement: No deterministic evidence was available for {{slot}}.
catalog.unavailableImplementation: Do not infer or implement this dimension without additional evidence.
catalog.recurringSequenceStatement: Across {{captures}} canonical captures, the observed section order starts with {{first}} and follows {{roles}}.
catalog.localSequenceStatement: One canonical capture starts with {{first}} and follows the observed section order {{roles}}.
catalog.sequenceImplementation: Preserve this order only where the cited captures support it; it describes observed sequence, not viewer gaze.
catalog.sequenceDistinctiveness: The same deterministic sequence is represented by {{captures}} canonical captures.
catalog.recurringEntryStatement: In observed section order, {{role}} is first in {{captures}} canonical captures; this does not claim viewer gaze.
catalog.localEntryStatement: In one canonical capture's observed section order, {{role}} is first; this does not claim viewer gaze.
catalog.entryImplementation: Use this only as captured section-order evidence, not as a claim about what viewers notice first.
catalog.containerStatement: The {{count}} detected canonical sections have a median normalized width of approximately {{width}}%.
catalog.alignmentStatement: {{count}} detected canonical sections use the dominant {{anchor}} anchor classification.
catalog.densityStatement: The {{captures}} canonical captures contain between {{minimum}} and {{maximum}} detected sections.
catalog.rhythmStatement: A canonical capture records the section sequence {{roles}}.
catalog.tokenOwnershipStatement: Rendered evidence owners reference {{count}} observed {{dimension}} token entries.
catalog.tokenOwnershipImplementation: Reuse only the cited token references on compatible observed owners; do not invent semantic roles.
catalog.typographyStatement: {{count}} canonical text nodes expose typography evidence for these roles: {{roles}}.
catalog.shapeStatement: {{count}} canonical component observations use these deterministic corner classifications: {{shapes}}.
catalog.surfaceStatement: Among {{count}} observed surface owners, {{bordered}} have visible borders and {{shadowed}} have visible shadows.
catalog.sectionCompositionStatement: {{count}} observed {{role}} sections use these layout modes: {{layouts}}.
catalog.sectionRhythmStatement: Observed {{role}} sections occur at detected sequence positions {{positions}}.
catalog.sectionTransitionStatement: Observed {{role}} sections are immediately followed by these detected roles: {{next}}.
catalog.componentStatement: {{count}} observed {{type}} components with role {{role}} use corner classes {{shapes}} and variants {{variants}}.
catalog.componentImplementation: Keep each cited component's own observed geometry and token ownership; do not collapse variants into one style.
catalog.interactionStatement: An observed {{safety}} {{driver}} state changes these properties: {{properties}}.
catalog.passiveInteractionImplementation: Treat passive state evidence as declared or computed styling only; it does not prove an executed user action.
catalog.activeInteractionImplementation: Reproduce only the cited executed property changes and transition metadata.
catalog.interactionFeedbackStatement: {{count}} state observations change {{properties}}; {{passive}} of them are passive observations.
catalog.interactionAmplitudeStatement: Each observed state changes between {{minimum}} and {{maximum}} recorded properties.
catalog.amplitudeImplementation: This is a property-count range, not a claim about perceived intensity or importance.
catalog.motionStatement: {{count}} interaction observations include deterministic transition metadata.
catalog.responsiveStatement: From {{from}} to {{to}}, the observed {{role}} section is classified as {{change}} and changes: {{properties}}.
catalog.responsiveImplementation: Apply every listed property change at the cited viewport transition; the list must not be shortened to an 'only' claim.
catalog.overflowStatement: The {{viewportName}} capture has severe horizontal overflow: {{content}}px content width in a {{viewport}}px viewport.
catalog.overflowImplementation: Treat this capture as an avoid rule and limitation; do not reuse its clipped geometry as responsive layout guidance.
catalog.scopeBoundaryStatement: The evidence covers {{urls}} URL groups at these captured viewports: {{viewports}}; behavior outside that scope was not observed.
catalog.scopeBoundaryImplementation: Do not generalize claims to uncaptured URLs, viewports, states, or content variants.
catalog.mediaStatement: {{count}} major media observations use kinds {{kinds}} with roles {{roles}}.

uncertainties.pageReason: Fewer URL groups were captured than requested.
uncertainties.captureReason: At least one planned page and viewport capture is missing.
uncertainties.captureNeeded: Complete the missing page and viewport captures.
uncertainties.healthReason: {{count}} capture(s) failed the deterministic page health gate and were excluded from reusable claims.
uncertainties.healthNeeded: Recapture the affected URL without blocking overlays, authentication walls, loading states, or error pages.
uncertainties.assetReason: At least one screenshot asset failed deterministic dimension validation.
uncertainties.assetNeeded: Recapture the affected screenshot and validate its encoded dimensions.
uncertainties.crossPageReason: Only one URL group is available, so site-wide recurrence cannot be established.
uncertainties.crossPageNeeded: Capture at least one structurally different URL from the same site.
uncertainties.interactionReason: No safely executed interaction observation is available; passive styles do not prove behavior.
uncertainties.interactionNeeded: Safely execute representative hover, focus, or click states.
uncertainties.responsivePresenceReason: A section appears in only one compared capture; absence alone does not prove CSS hiding or removal.
uncertainties.responsivePresenceNeeded: Match the same section across both viewports or observe a direct display or visibility change.
uncertainties.responsiveIdentityReason: A repeated DOM path had different semantic section roles across viewports, so no responsive relationship was asserted for that pair.
uncertainties.responsiveIdentityNeeded: Confirm the same semantic section in both viewports before comparing its responsive changes.
uncertainties.overflowReason: At least one capture is clipped and excluded from reusable layout inference.
uncertainties.overflowNeeded: Capture a non-overflowing viewport before inferring responsive layout.
uncertainties.sectionNeeded: Capture a healthy page with detectable structural regions.

componentShape.mixedImplementation: Implement each variant with its observed corner shape; do not generalize all cited components to one silhouette.
componentShape.primaryStatement: The cited primary button is a compact solid pill with an accent fill and contrasting foreground.
componentShape.primaryImplementation: Keep the observed pill silhouette and compact size for the primary CTA; do not rewrite it as square or small-radius.

responsive.headerStatement: Header positioning changes from {{from}} to {{to}} across {{transition}}{{companionClause}}.
responsive.headerImplementation: Implement the positioning change at the observed viewport range{{companionClause}}.
responsive.headerImplementationCompanion: and preserve {{properties}} changes from the same responsive evidence
responsive.mobilePartialCoverage: {{captured}} of {{expected}} planned page×viewport captures completed; the uncaptured viewport and cross-page consistency still need confirmation.
responsive.mobileObservedCoverage: These facts apply only to captured pages; other pages and cross-page consistency still need confirmation.
responsive.mobileReason: {{captures}} mobile page/viewport captures include screenshots, and {{sequences}} include section sequences; {{coverage}}
responsive.mobilePartialNeeded: The uncaptured mobile viewport and cross-page consistency
responsive.mobileObservedNeeded: Mobile structure on other pages and cross-page consistency
